headline: Contra learns to duck — kneel, prone, and fire under the fire
lede: The shelf's weakest kick (CONTRA -1 weak, every README gap closed) pointed at the one pose missing from the cabinet: DOWN now kneels, DOWN again lies flat. The muzzle drops to deck-height, the body shrinks under aimed rounds, and crawling at half speed keeps it honest — while every pre-duck seed replay stays byte-for-byte.

notes.text: posture per seat in the shared seatStep: stand/kneel/prone cycles on DOWN edges, UP stands, jumps stand you back into the somersault; the blue seat ducks under the identical code and the shouted AIM DOWN now takes the wingman to a knee.

the profile takes the hit where the drawn body lies: chest-line rounds pass OVER a prone hero, head-high rounds sink under the kneel — but deck blasts, soldiers and the torrent stay lethal, and the crawl is the price (contracheck proves both directions).

harness: 278/278 sim+browser, 192/192 mutants — three new named deaths (duck-deaf, prone-immortal, no-crawl-price). Two probe traps found on the way: the wingman's own rifle streams into gs.pb (grade o:0 rounds only), and a grenade at the feet is graded by BLAST radius, not contact, or a cheat hides behind the touch kill.
#3030's merge-wrapper read-fail shape recurred and the law held: exit criterion from the PR state (MERGED), cleanup by hand — lane re-detached, remote branch gone.

look.text: Contra's duck: two taps of DOWN, fire off the deck, crawl under the jungle'…
The somersault from this morning — jump and the whole body turns
